content.title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline
content.summary: The guideline provides a comprehensive overview and the latest recommendations on the management and treatment of heart failure. It covers various strategies including exercise-based rehabilitation, diuretics use, and medications like angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers, and more. The guideline emphasizes the importance of personalized treatment plans and evidence-based practices to improve patient outcomes.
